 This Petition, Coming On For Orders, This Day,
Order Was Made Therein As Under:
Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice M.Nagaprasanna
 Oral Order
The petitioners - husband and his family members are before this Court calling in question
proceedings in C.C.No.59683/2023, pending before the Xi Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate,
Bengaluru, for the offences punishable under Section 498A of the Ipc and Sections 3 and 4 of the
Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961.

Nc: 2026:Khc:10747 Hc-Kar
2.

Learned counsel for the petitioners and respondent No.2 in unison submit that the parties to the lis were before the concerned family Court in C.Misc.No.276/2023 and have settled their matrimonial dispute amicably by drawing up certain terms and conditions before the Lok Adalath and therefore, they are before this Court seeking permission to compound the offences.
The parties have filed a photocopy of the compromise petition entered into between them in C.Misc.No.276/2023 before this Court to that effect.

3. The compromise petition filed before the Lok Adalath reads as follows:
